title: SUPPLIER_TIMEOUT: the order may exist, the reconciler decides
caption: Flight Create Orders without a readable answer (timeout, Amadeus 5xx) never fails the booking blindly. The worker searches the OTA's booking queue for the remark VELEXIS <reference> for 15 minutes (ota/docs/architecture-booking.md §4, src/bookings/reconcile.service.ts, reconcile.processor.ts).

steps.label: 504 SUPPLIER_TIMEOUT {bookingId}; replays with K answer the same while undecided
every minute (bookings.reconcile_scan): Queue List of the booking queue (max 500)
by-reference GET of each candidate PNR (created −1…+5 min, lead last name), ≤ 50 per attempt
match general remark VELEXIS <reference> (a name match alone never counts)
found: record the order, reconcile_outcome = found, checkout completed
found: capture the booking's total, then issue per ticketing_policy
not found (complete search, Stripe): booking failed, checkout open again, booking.not_confirmed e-mail, staff alert
undecided at deadline or airline card: reconcile_outcome = manual_review, ticketing_status = manual_review, staff.manual_review e-mail
steps.note: Staff close it in the OTA admin: POST /v1/console/bookings/{id}/review-closure (order found / not booked).
